name: plugin-react-query
description: Generates typed TanStack Query helpers for React from your OpenAPI spec: queryOptions and mutationOptions factories with their cache keys. Set hooks to also get useQuery and useMutation hooks, plus useInfiniteQuery when infinite is set.

options.label: Barrel
options.description: How index.ts barrel files are generated

options.label: Output Mode
options.description: How the plugin consolidates its code into files. File mode writes everything into a single file, so the output path must include a file extension and cannot be grouped.

options.label: Client
options.description: HTTP client the generated hooks call. Only needed to disambiguate when both plugin-fetch and plugin-axios are enabled

options.label: Group
options.description: Group generated operations by OpenAPI tag or path

options.label: Exclude Tags
options.description: Comma-separated OpenAPI tags to exclude from generation

options.label: Include Tags
options.description: Comma-separated OpenAPI tags to include. Only operations with these tags are generated

options.label: Hooks
options.description: Generate use* functions instead of only queryOptions and mutation helpers

options.label: Suspense
options.description: Add useSuspenseQuery hooks alongside useQuery (TanStack Query v5+)

options.label: Infinite Query Param
options.description: Enable infinite queries, set the pageParam key (e.g. "id"). Leave empty to disable.

options.label: Query Methods
options.description: Comma-separated HTTP methods treated as queries (default: GET)

options.label: Query Import Path
options.description: Module specifier the generated query hook imports from

options.label: Mutation Methods
options.description: Comma-separated HTTP methods treated as mutations (default: POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)

options.label: Mutation Import Path
options.description: Module specifier the generated mutation hook imports from

options.label: Custom Options Import Path
options.description: Module of your hook that adds options to every generated query and mutation

options.label: Custom Options Name
options.description: Exported name of that hook, useCustomHookOptions when empty. Needs the import path

options.label: Banner
options.description: Text added at the top of every generated file

options.label: Footer
options.description: Text added at the end of every generated file
